item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 01/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will cover the coastal areas and the northern part of the South China Sea. A dry northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Friday. It will become fine over the region. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, it will be cool in the morning and at night over the coast of southern China during the weekend to midweek next week. The temperature difference between day and night over inland areas will be rather large.

Wind: East to northeast force 4, occasionally force 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches at first. Bright periods during the day.
Temp range: 17 - 21 C
R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
